_comment: Weekly sales report email (owner request 2026-10-22). Sent by the server scheduler once per Monday-to-Sunday week at sendTime (America/New_York; weekday 0 = Sunday). enabled: false keeps the schedule off while the owner reviews test sends from the admin route; flip it to true to start the Sunday sends (no restart needed). recipients: every address the scheduled send goes to. from: the sender shown on the email; the Gmail account that sends it is GMAIL_USER in .env (must be this address or one of its aliases). subject: {range} becomes the Monday-to-Sunday date range. catchUpHours: if the server was down at send time, the report still goes out when it comes back within this many hours, never later and never twice. workingDays: the business-day calendar for month-to-date pacing (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday). flags: underGoalShare = a rep is flagged when combined submissions are below this share of their weekly goal; showRateDropPoints = a show rate drop of at least this many percentage points week over week is flagged. dashboardUrl: public address of the live dashboard for the footer links; empty = AUTH_URL from the environment. theme: light (the dashboard's light bands) or dark (its dark navy bands); the layout is the same, only the colors change. The admin preview route accepts ?theme=light|dark to compare.
subject: VCN Weekly Sales Report: {range}
